info.title: Admin API
info.description:
The API behind the admin app, under `/admin/v1`. It is internal: it changes with the app and is documented for people working on it. Served only when `DEBUG` is on.

**Signing in.** Every call except a few public ones needs the `sid` session cookie (`__Host-sid` with secure cookies), set by the passkey sign-in or invite flow. In production the whole app also sits behind Cloudflare Access.

**Roles** (`x-role` on each operation):
- `public`: no session needed.
- `signed_in`: any signed-in member.
- `company:approver`: owners and approvers, who see every brand.
- `company:owner`: owners only.
- `brand:viewer`, `brand:editor`, `brand:sender`, `brand:brand_admin`: at least that role on the brand in the path (`{slug}`). Owners hold every brand role. A brand the member can't see answers 404 `not_found`; one they can see without the role, 403 `forbidden`. Approvers can see every brand, and count as viewers where an operation says so.

**Step-up** (`x-step-up: true`): the call also needs a passkey confirmation from the last few minutes (`POST /auth/stepup/begin` and `/finish`). Without it the answer is 403 `step_up_required`.

**Errors** are JSON: `{"error": {"code": "…", "message": "…"}}`. The code is stable and machine-readable; the message is for people. Each operation lists its codes in `x-error-codes`. Any call can also fail with 500 `internal`.

**Writes** must send `Content-Type: application/json` (cross-site writes are refused) and bodies may not have unknown fields (400 `bad_json`).

session.name: sid
session.description: Session cookie from the passkey sign-in (`__Host-sid` when secure cookies are on).

BrandRoles.description: Brand ID → the member's role on that brand.

BadJSON.description: `bad_json`: the body isn't valid JSON for this call, or has unknown fields.

Forbidden.description: `forbidden`: the member's role doesn't allow this.

ForbiddenOrStepUp.description: `forbidden`: the member's role doesn't allow this. `step_up_required`: confirm with a passkey first.

NotFound.description: `not_found`: nothing with that ID or slug (or the member can't see it).
